master.title: TRANSPARENCY PRODUCTS BY PPG FOR THE AEROSPACE INDUSTRY
master.content:
PPG Aerospace - Transparencies is a leader in military transparency technology. We are an experienced developer and system supplier of upgraded and retrofit military transparencies in the industry. The system upgrades we provide include energy-absorbing internal and external coatings, increased bird impact resistance with no increase in transparency weight, increased pilot vision with wraparound windshields, increased transparency service life, and quick replacement of transparencies for decreased maintenance downtime.

PPG Aerospace is a leading innovative producer of conductive coatings for transparency applications, from low observables and electrical heating to solar infrared, ultra violet, night vision, and laser protection.

PPG Aerospace offers worldwide customer technical support.

candidate.title: TRANSPARENCY PRODUCTS BY PPG FOR THE AEROSPACE INDUSTRY
candidate.content:
PPG Aerospace Transparencies has a long history of being a leading supplier of flight deck windows to the general aviation industry.  PPG has key partnerships with most OEMs globally including, but not limited to, Bombardier, Dassault, Beechcraft, Cessna, Embraer, Gulfstream, Piaggio, Pilatus, Piper, Agusta, Bell, Sikorsky and Eclipse.  PPG operates the world’s largest footprint of manufacturing facilities designed and dedicated to the fabrication of Aerospace windows.

PPG leads the aerospace industry in technology development for aircraft windows.  PPG pioneered the development of chemically strengthened glass, complex transparent heating films, composite light weight windows, and structurally loaded cockpit windows.  More recently PPG has introduced Alteos®

internative window systems or electrically dimmable cabin windows for better light management in the fuselage and an enhanced customer experience.  PPG has also introduced and certified Opticor™ advanced transparency material, the only new transparent plastic for use in windows since the development of stretched acrylic.  This new material is in lighter weight than stretched acrylic and almost completely craze resistant extending product life and reducing cost of ownership. 

PPG can also provide windows direct to operators for several general aviation aircraft including, but not limited to Lear 45, Lear 31, Bombardier Global Express and Challenger model aircraft, Hawker 750, 800, 850, 900, 1000, Embraer Legacy 600/650 and King Air.  Please contact PPG today so we can support you with your current general aviation window needs.
